item.title: Alleged 2.28bn fraud: Court takes action against 2 Abuja socialites
item.description: High Court denies bail to Abuja socialite Prince Chibuike Echem and Danjuma Mohammed in multi-billion-naira fraud case linked to alleged contract scams.

item.title: Cubana Chiefpriest's ex-staff speaks about him, makes allegation
item.description: Emir Sirdam reveals insights into Cubana Chiefpriest amid betrayal allegations, detailing his experiences working with the controversial businessman.

item.title: 2027 election: North Central youths announce who they will support, pledge 5m votes
item.description: North Central Youths Support Group pledges five million votes for President Tinubu in 2027. Leaders stress voter registration and highlight economic reform benefits.

item.title: Tension as Ganduje knocks El-Rufai over fresh allegation
item.description: Abdullahi Ganduje, former governor of Kano, has reacted to the allegation by his counterparts in Kaduna, Nasir El-Rufai, over the disappearance of popular activist.

item.title: Why Enugu REC must not be redeployed to Imo, group tells INEC
item.description: A coalition of Civil Society Organisations in Imo state has urged INEC to stop the alleged planned redeployment of Enugu REC, Dr Chukwuemeka Chukwu, to Imo state.

item.title: DR Congo makes late approach to get favourable verdict from FIFA
item.description: DR Congo sought a favourable FIFA verdict on the dual national players' ineligibility amid Nigeria's challenge for the 2026 World Cup qualification.

item.title: PSG manager Enrique responds to Dembele's criticism following loss to Rennes, video
item.description: Paris Saint-Germain suffered a 3-1 defeat to Rennes, with Ousmane Dembele's criticism of teammates prompting a strong rebuttal from coach Luis Enrique.

item.title: Breaking: Tension as another Tinubu's minister dragged to court over certificate saga
item.description: Another President Bola Tinubu's powerful minister has been dragged to court over certificate scandal. The Federal High Court in Abuja has also given an order.

item.title: Pastor John Anosike releases prophecy on solar collapse, chaos, ‘viruses in the sun’
item.description: Nigerian cleric, Pastor John Anosike, has shared a notable prophecy warning of solar collapse, extreme weather, and alleged plans to “cast viruses in the sun".

item.title: Find out mor as US dollar exchange rate rises against naira
item.description: The Naira depreciated slightly against the Dollar at NAFEM amid strong demand and CBN’s non-intervention, but recorded gains against the Pound and Euro.
